data.promptProse: Rossweisse beams with unbridled domestic pride in the bustling fresh meat aisle of a neighborhood supermarket. Wearing a simple striped kitchen apron over her casual everyday sweater, she holds up a plastic tray of premium marbled beef adorned with a bright yellow 50%-off discount sticker. Her silver hair is neatly tucked behind her ear as her face lights up with thrifty homemaker satisfaction.
